query:
UPDATE kanban_tasks SET
            goal_phase = CASE WHEN $1 = '' THEN goal_phase ELSE $2 END,
            goal_blocked_code = CASE WHEN $3 = '' THEN goal_blocked_code
                ELSE NULLIF($4, '')::text END,
            goal_blocked_message = CASE WHEN $5 = $6 THEN goal_blocked_message
                ELSE NULLIF($7, '')::text END,
            goal_max_rounds = CASE WHEN $8 = $9 THEN goal_max_rounds
                ELSE NULLIF($10, '')::int END,
            goal_revision = goal_revision + 1,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $11
